summary: EXPLAIN census over the 175 failing files (oracle PostgreSQL 18.4). 88 files contain EXPLAIN; 87 contain none. 1,874 EXPLAIN statements yield a plan block (80 of them through PL/pgSQL wrappers: explain_filter 28, explain_memoize 13, explain_mask_costs 12, explain_parallel_append 12, explain_merge 8, others 7); 14,924 expected plan rows (20,546 lines with header/ruler/count). Changed lines inside QUERY PLAN blocks: 27,158 strict / 27,230 block-attributed of 110,197 (24.6%); file_stats.json's rough 27,138 agrees. Only 33 of 1,874 expected blocks are byte-identical today; Gres prints 1,477 blocks (5,515 rows, 15 node types) and errors on ~397 statements. Attribution: 15,971 lines (58.6%, 1,128 blocks) sit in blocks that contain a cost-chosen node/annotation and can ONLY be matched by a PostgreSQL-faithful cost-based planner + renderer; 6,592 lines (24.2%, 746 blocks) are non-cost plan-shape work (inheritance/partition child expansion, VERBOSE Output, InitPlan/SubPlan, One-Time Filter folding, CTE/WindowAgg/ProjectSet/SetOp/MERGE nodes, deparse); 4,667 lines (17.1%) are statements Gres refuses (largest single root: user-defined SRF in the select list, routine.rs validate_plpgsql_scalar, which kills all wrapper-based EXPLAINs and cascades select_parallel; then relation-missing cascades in partition_prune/updatable_views/inherit/partition_join, and parser gaps). Outside plan blocks, stats_ext prints 762 changed lines of estimated|actual selectivity values (Gres answers 0) and misc_functions 6 literal rows= estimates. Corpus is overwhelmingly COSTS OFF (1,834/1,874); literal costs appear in exactly 1 statement (inherit), masked cost=N..N in 39 (explain 25, misc_functions 12, incremental_sort 2). ANALYZE 117 statements (11 files; 89 blocks show actual rows, 28 masked), VERBOSE 271 (33 files). 50% of expected blocks (942) run under a non-default planner GUC (enable_* off, parallel costs zeroed, work_mem…); 724 of the 1,128 planner-only blocks are GUC-forced. Test-setup VACUUM ANALYZE (tenk1/tenk2/onek/onek2/person/emp/…) feeds join/create_index/subselect/select_parallel/aggregates/window; 33 files ANALYZE their own tables (partition_join 67, stats_ext 64, join 19…); Gres ANALYZE stores only reltuples (relstats.rs), no pg_statistic.

costs_visible: Literal costs are visible in exactly 1 expected statement in the whole failing corpus: inherit.out 'explain update parted_tab set a = 2 where false;' -> 'Update on parted_tab  (cost=0.00..0.00 rows=0 width=0)' / '->  Result  (cost=0.00..0.00 rows=0 width=10)' / 'One-Time Filter: false' (3 rows). 1,834 of 1,874 statements use COSTS OFF. Masked costs (cost=N..N / cost=N.N..N.N) appear in 39 statements via PL/pgSQL wrappers: explain 25 (explain_filter, also masks rows=N width=N time=N.N and Planning/Execution Time), misc_functions 12 (explain_mask_costs; 6 of them deliberately keep the literal row estimate 'rows=30', 'rows=5', 'rows=1' from generate_series_timestamp SupportRequestRows), incremental_sort 2 (explain_analyze_without_memory). Actual rows/loops are literal in 89 blocks across 10 files (partition_prune 51, brin_multi 9, merge 8, misc_functions 8, select_into 3, select_parallel 3, incremental_sort 2, matview 2, tidscan 2, select 1) and masked in 28 (explain 15, memoize 13). Row estimates also leak outside plan blocks: stats_ext check_estimated_rows() 382 calls -> 762 changed 'estimated | actual' lines (Gres prints 0 for every estimate); join_hash hash_join_batches() 19 calls read Hash Batches from EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON).
stats_dependence: test_setup.out runs VACUUM ANALYZE (pg_statistic + relpages/reltuples) on onek, onek2, tenk1, tenk2, person, emp, student, stud_emp, road, ihighway, shighway, and plain VACUUM (relpages/reltuples only, no pg_statistic) on CHAR_TBL, FLOAT8_TBL, INT2_TBL, INT4_TBL, INT8_TBL, TEXT_TBL, VARCHAR_TBL; point_tbl is deliberately left unvacuumed. Gres ANALYZE stores only reltuples (crates/pgexec/src/relstats.rs) and relhassubclass; there is no pg_statistic (no MCV/histogram/ndistinct/correlation/nullfrac), no relpages, and CREATE STATISTICS is refused (0A000). Files whose EXPLAINs mostly read the setup tables and therefore need those stats: join (155 refs: tenk1 47, int4_tbl 45, int8_tbl 44, onek 11, text_tbl 6), create_index (tenk1 41, point_tbl 14, tenk2 4), subselect (onek 20, tenk1 12, int8_tbl 9, tenk2 7), select_parallel (tenk1 41, tenk2 9), aggregates (tenk1 22), window (emp 19, tenk1 4), explain (int8_tbl 18), union (tenk1 9, int8_tbl 4), incremental_sort (tenk1 12), select (onek2 9), strings (text_tbl 9), groupingsets (tenk1 7), rowtypes (tenk1 5), with, limit, tidscan, memoize, misc_functions, write_parallel, tablesample, equivclass, rangefuncs, plpgsql. Files that ANALYZE their own tables before EXPLAIN (need an ANALYZE that fills pg_statistic): partition_join 67, stats_ext 64, join 19, partition_aggregate 8, inherit 8, incremental_sort 6, create_index 6, aggregates 6, rowsecurity 4, updatable_views 4, btree_index 4, plpgsql 4, alter_table 4, join_hash 3 (plus 'update pg_class set reltuples' to lie), memoize 3, privileges 3, predicate 2, rangetypes 2, merge 2, groupingsets 2, partition_prune 2, and 12 files with 1 (union, select_distinct, select_distinct_on, select, plancache, jsonb, tsearch, gin, create_view, generated_virtual, generated_stored, ...). Files with no ANALYZE that still expect index plans rely on GUC forcing (enable_seqscan/indexscan/bitmapscan off): create_index_spgist 71 stmts, box, polygon, gist, gin, brin/brin_bloom/brin_multi, cluster, inet, regex, tsearch, indexing, jsonb, interval, spgist, index_including(_gist), create_am, generated_stored — 942 of 1,874 blocks (50%) run under some non-default planner GUC, 724 of the 1,128 planner-only blocks. Plan shapes that only make sense with real row estimates: 'Index Scan using tenk1_unique1 on tenk1' for unique1 < 10 vs Seq Scan for wide ranges (join/create_index/aggregates); Hash vs Merge vs Nested Loop and which side is hashed/materialized (join: 137 Materialize, 400 Hash; partition_join with 200-row analyzed partitions); Memoize placement (memoize/join/predicate/subselect); Incremental Sort vs Sort from presorted-prefix estimates (incremental_sort); parallel plans gated by parallel_setup_cost=0/parallel_tuple_cost=0/min_parallel_table_scan_size=0 + parallel_workers reloption; MIN/MAX planagg to Result/InitPlan/Limit/Index Only Scan Backward (aggregates); GROUP BY key reordering and presorted aggregates (aggregates/groupingsets); stats_ext extended-statistics selectivity (762 lines); misc_functions SupportRequestRows estimates; join_hash batch counts from reltuples/work_mem.
planner_requirements: To reproduce the corpus a planner must model, in rough order of corpus coverage (blocks of the 1,874 expected; lines of the 27,230 attributed): (1) A resolved query tree instead of the raw AST as the EXPLAIN input, with PostgreSQL's target-list/qual deparse rules (ruleutils.c: qualify columns only when >1 RTE, VERBOSE Output lists incl. schema-qualified relation/function names, operator/cast/const spelling) — touches every block; VERBOSE Output alone is 269 blocks / 3,316 lines / 33 files. (2) prepjointree.c/subselect.c/planner.c preprocessing: subquery pull-up into Subquery Scan or flattened joins, InitPlan/SubPlan numbering and hashed-subplan choice, `(InitPlan 1).col1` references (126 blocks, 1,873 lines), constant folding + predicate proofs (predtest.c) into `Result`/`One-Time Filter: false` (100 blocks), CTE materialization rules -> `CTE x` headers, CTE Scan/WorkTable Scan/Recursive Union (46 blocks), join removal (analyzejoins.c) and self-join elimination (join), outer-join strength reduction, EXISTS/IN -> Semi/Anti joins. (3) Inheritance/partition expansion + partprune.c static pruning + runtime pruning bookkeeping (`Append`/`Merge Append` with `t1 t1_1` child aliases, `Subplans Removed`, `never executed`) — 457 blocks / ~7,900 lines across partition_prune, partition_join, partition_aggregate, inherit, rowsecurity, alter_table, tablesample, update; partitionwise join/aggregate (relnode.c/partbounds.c) is the whole of partition_join (3,218 planner lines) and partition_aggregate (954). (4) indxpath.c + selfuncs.c/clausesel.c: index path generation with Index Cond/Filter split, Index Only Scan visibility (Heap Fetches), Backward scans from pathkeys, Bitmap Heap/Index Scan + BitmapAnd/Or + Recheck Cond, KNN `Order By`, regex/LIKE prefix extraction, tidpath.c Tid/Tid Range scans (TID Cond) — 579 blocks / 5,973 lines / 47 files, about two-thirds under enable_seqscan=off so `disabled_nodes` semantics (PG18 `Disabled: true`) matter more than fine cost ratios; requires pg_statistic (ANALYZE) for tenk1/onek-class tables and reltuples/relpages for the rest. (5) joinpath.c/joinrels.c/costsize.c: join order search (left/right/bushy, join_collapse_limit, geqo threshold), Nested Loop vs Hash vs Merge with all outer/semi/anti/right-semi/right-anti variants, which side is hashed (`Hash` under inner), Materialize on the nested-loop inner, Memoize (Cache Key/Mode, Inner Unique), Merge Cond/Hash Cond/Join Filter split, equivclass.c derived clauses (equivclass file), Sort placement for merge joins — 279 join-method blocks / 5,254 lines plus 345 Nested Loop blocks whose side order is cost-chosen (join is the flagship: 2,620 planner lines). (6) pathkeys.c + planner.c grouping/ordering: Sort vs Incremental Sort (Presorted Key), HashAggregate vs GroupAggregate vs Sort+Unique, MixedAggregate for grouping sets (Hash Key lists), Group, GROUP BY reordering, presorted aggregates (adjust_group_pathkeys_for_groupagg), planagg.c MIN/MAX -> Result/InitPlan/Limit/Index Only Scan Backward, DISTINCT via Unique or index, WindowAgg with PG18 `Window:` line and Run Condition, SetOp/HashSetOp for INTERSECT/EXCEPT, LockRows, ProjectSet — 358+75+55 blocks (~7,000 lines) in aggregates, groupingsets, incremental_sort, union, window, select_distinct(_on), tuplesort, subselect. (7) Parallel planning (allpaths.c/planner.c/costsize.c parallel costs): Gather/Gather Merge, Parallel Seq/Index/Index Only/Bitmap scans, Parallel Append, Parallel Hash (Join), Partial/Finalize aggregates, Workers Planned/Launched, Single Copy, parallel_workers reloption, parallel_leader_participation, debug_parallel_query — 120 blocks / 1,850 lines / 11 files (select_parallel, partition_aggregate, incremental_sort, select_distinct, aggregates, join_hash, memoize, write_parallel, partition_prune, partition_join, plpgsql). (8) createplan.c/setrefs.c + explain.c renderer parity: node naming (`Index Scan using i on t alias`, `Function Scan on fn alias`, `Values Scan on "*VALUES*"`, `Table Function Scan on "json_table"/"xmltable"`, `Sample Scan` + `Sampling:`, `Merge on t` + `Tuples:`, ON CONFLICT lines), InitPlan/SubPlan/CTE headers, `Disabled`, JSON/YAML/XML formats, and executor instrumentation for ANALYZE (`actual rows/loops`, `never executed`, `Rows Removed by Filter`, `Sort Method`/`Memory`, `Heap Fetches`, `Index Searches`, Memoize Hits/Misses, `Storage`, Planning/Execution Time, `Buffers`, MEMORY/SERIALIZE/SETTINGS/Query Identifier lines) — 117 ANALYZE statements / 1,572 lines plus the `explain` file (444 lines) and every FORMAT block. (9) Statistics: ANALYZE writing pg_statistic (MCV, histogram, ndistinct, nullfrac, width, correlation) with default_statistics_target, relpages/reltuples, extended statistics (stats_ext 762 estimate lines + CREATE STATISTICS), function ROWS/support functions (misc_functions), and `update pg_class set reltuples` (join_hash). (10) GUC plumbing for ~45 planner GUCs (enable_*, parallel_*, work_mem/hash_mem_multiplier, plan_cache_mode generic vs custom, constraint_exclusion, geqo, join/from_collapse_limit, jit) with SET LOCAL/RESET/savepoint semantics. Rough phasing by payoff: (a) resolved-tree renderer + deparse + inheritance/partition expansion + InitPlan/SubPlan + node coverage (non-cost, ~6,600 lines directly and a precondition for everything else); (b) statistics + index/bitmap/tid paths honoring enable_* (≈6,000 lines, mostly GUC-forced); (c) join methods/order + Materialize/Memoize + equivalence classes (≈5,300 + Nested Loop reorders); (d) grouping/ordering/window/setop placement (≈7,000 lines shared with a-c); (e) parallel plans (≈1,850); (f) ANALYZE instrumentation and rare EXPLAIN options (≈2,000). Everything except (a) needs the cost model of costsize.c to pick the same path PostgreSQL picks; with COSTS OFF the numbers themselves never print except in the 1 inherit statement and the estimate tables of stats_ext/misc_functions.
